'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Jan B DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan B]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
